scope: Every Source in v1 (GOV-SD-07). status: exists / partial / new for the producer as of 2026-11-21.
simulationRule: GOV-SD-16: until its producer exists, every input is a SURFACE_SPEC simulated Source through the ISRE, one per input cell, deterministic in globalStep (constant, binary, square). Drive: reset RE and PE, create the simulation's sources, push `steps` times; the machine's output region after each push is expectedOutputsByStep (outputs are latched, GOV-SD-19). The feedbackCell has no Source: the engine feeds it.
